subject: [PATCH] mm/mempolicy: take a cpuset cookie for the interleave node count

reviews.author: Huang Ying
reviews.summary: Identified the issue as a torn read of the nodemask_t due to concurrent cpuset rebinds. Suggested taking a cpuset cookie around the count and retrying if the mask becomes invalid.

2026-09-01.patch_summary: This patch addresses a memory allocation issue in the Linux kernel's mm/mempolicy module, specifically in the alloc_pages_bulk_interleave function. The problem arises when a concurrent cpuset rebind can cause a torn read of the nodemask_t, leading to an empty mask and incorrect node count. To fix this, the patch takes a cpuset cookie around the count and retries if the mask becomes invalid.
